interface.longDescription: A private ChatGPT plugin for greetings, specialist workflow skills, live tool discovery, dependency-based plans, evaluation, and safe improvement. A greeting-only message gets an AgentOS reply without delegating or calling tools. Specialist role profiles are reusable instructions; separate parallel workers require native subagent support from the active ChatGPT host. Optional lifecycle hooks run only in compatible runtimes that execute and trust plugin scripts. No external MCP service or standalone agent runtime is included.
interface.shortDescription: ChatGPT workflow orchestration and specialist roles
